claims: The World Trade Organization (WTO) is the only global international organization managing rules of trade between nations.
WTO was established in 1995.
WTO serves 166 members.
WTO members account for 98% of world trade.
WTO negotiates agreements.
WTO settles disputes.
WTO monitors trade policies.
WTO sets rules for international commerce in goods.
WTO sets rules for international commerce in services.
WTO sets rules for international commerce in intellectual property.
WTO provides a system to resolve trade conflicts between member countries.
WTO reviews national trade policies.
WTO ensures transparency.
WTO assists developing economies to participate in the global trading system.
WTO rules are based on agreements signed by member countries and ratified in their parliaments.
WTO's most-favoured-nation principle involves treating all members equally.
WTO's national treatment principle involves treating foreigners and locals equally.
WTO requires members to disclose trade regulations.
WTO allows flexibility for environmental protection.
WTO allows flexibility for national security.
WTO allows flexibility for developing country needs.
WTO decisions are made by member governments through consensus.
WTO Ministerial Conference occurs every two years.
WTO General Council is in Geneva.
All WTO decisions are adopted by consensus of all members.
WTO Secretariat is located in Geneva, Switzerland.
WTO Secretariat provides administrative support.
WTO Secretariat is currently led by Director-General Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala
